content: This medication is indicated for the treatment of pruritus associated with progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis (PFIC) at a dosage of 40 mcg/kg administered orally once daily in the morning. It is also indicated for pruritus associated with Alagille syndrome (ALGS) at a dosage of 120 mcg/kg administered orally once daily in the morning. For patients aged 3 months or older with PFIC, the medication is approved for pruritus management. However, for patients under 3 months of age, the safety and efficacy of this treatment have not been established. For patients aged 1 year or older with ALGS, the medication is approved for pruritus management. However, for patients under 1 year of age, the safety and efficacy of this treatment have not been established. Administer bile acid sequestrants at least 4 hours before or after odevixibat. There is a pregnancy safety study that monitors outcomes in women exposed to this medication during pregnancy. Pregnant women or their healthcare providers should report exposure by calling 1-855-252-4736. There are no human data available on the use of this medication in pregnant females to determine the risk of major birth defects, miscarriage, or adverse developmental outcomes. Odevixibat has low absorption following oral administration, and breastfeeding is not expected to result in significant exposure to the infant. No data are available on the presence of odevixibat in human milk, its effects on breastfed infants, or its effects on milk production. The medication may reduce the absorption of fat-soluble vitamins (FSVs). Monitor FSV levels and increase FSV intake if a deficiency occurs during lactation. The contents of the shell containing oral pellets should be mixed into soft food or liquid. Do not allow children to swallow unopened shells containing pellets. Administer the medication in the morning with a meal. For patients taking bile acid-binding resins, administer the medication at least 4 hours before or after taking the resin. Capsules should be swallowed whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew them. Store the medication at 20-25°C (68-77°F), with excursions permitted to 15-30°C (59-86°F).
